about_the_game:
One Million Coins is a short, first-person incremental game about turning a pile of coins into a fully upgraded excavation operation.

You begin with empty pockets and your bare hands in a vault containing exactly one million coins. Collect gold directly from the enormous coin pile, carry it to a deposit station, and use your banked earnings to buy better equipment. Every upgrade makes the next haul faster, bigger, and more satisfying.

Start by scooping coins by hand, then unlock a growing set of increasingly powerful tools. Buy pouches and backpacks to carry larger loads, invest in a 250+ node skill tree that improves movement, reach, collection speed, tool strength, capacity, and deposit rate, and excavate deeper into the bunker to restore its infrastructure.

One Million Coins is designed as a short, focused experience. Most players should be able to work their way through the vault in around 2 hours.

Bank Every Haul

Bring your collected gold to the deposit station, turn it into spendable funds, and prepare for your next upgrade.

Shape Your Excavation Build

Spend your earnings across an 250+ node skill tree to improve speed, capacity, reach, tool power, and deposit efficiency.

Become a Gold-Collecting Machine

Build toward high-powered late-game tools that pull in huge waves of coins and transform the vault into your personal gold rush.

  • First-person, hands-on coin collecting

  • A finite vault containing exactly 1,000,000 coins

  • Incremental progression with increasingly powerful collection tools

  • An 250+ node skill tree across seven upgrade paths

  • Expand your carry capacity with bags and skill upgrades

  • Restore deposit stations, cargo lifts, conveyors, and bunker infrastructure

  • Dig deeper into the underground vault at your own pace

  • Work toward collecting every last coin and emptying the bunker completely
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
requirements_recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
